name: WordHero
description_en:
WordHero’s current version organizes content marketing around projects and Canvases. A team supplies audience, offer and brand voice, then turns one brief into related emails, social posts, advertisements, article drafts and visuals.

The value proposition is reusable context and connected campaign assets. Outputs still need review for factual consistency, brand tone and rights; a common brief does not ensure every channel says the same thing. The originally listed WordHero routes redirected to the current page at aivolut.com/wordhero when read.
description_zh:
WordHero 当前版本用项目与 Canvas 组织内容营销，输入受众、产品和品牌声音，再把一个简报转为邮件、社交、广告、文章及图片。

价值在复用上下文并连接活动素材；结果仍需核事实一致性、品牌及权利，共用简报不保证各渠道表达相同。 本次读取时，原 WordHero 路径跳转到 aivolut.com/wordhero 当前页面。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep several outputs from one brief together for review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将同一简报多种输出集中审核。

core_features.explanation_en: Reuse audience, offer and voice across recurring work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 重复工作复用受众、产品和声音。

en: Create a coherent launch email, social draft and article outline from approved facts.
zh: 从已批准事实生成一致的发布邮件、社交和提纲。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Set project facts, generate a Canvas and inspect every asset before any WordPress publication.
steps.zh: 设项目事实、生成 Canvas，发布 WordPress 前审核每份素材。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual subscription with project, voice, enhanced AI and search/image allowances.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual Starter $180, Pro $348, Business $708, equivalent $15/$29/$59 per month. Standard fair use; Enhanced/search/image/project/team limits apply. Seven-day card-required trial; old-customer V2 terms need confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 年 Starter $180、Pro $348、Business $708，折月 $15/$29/$59。Standard 合理使用，增强/搜索/图片/项目/团队有限，七天需卡试用，旧客户 V2 条款待确认。

sources.title: AI Content Writer for Marketing & SEO | WordHero
sources.research_notes_en: Current V2 campaign Canvas, project memory, brand voices, article and image workflows; older-version migration not assumed.

sources.title: AI Content Writer for Marketing & SEO | WordHero
sources.research_notes_en: Homepage pricing section also returned by pricing URL; annual totals, fair-use standard writing and seven-day card-required trial.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Review a campaign as one factual set
sections.title_zh: 把活动作为一组事实审核
sections.en: For an illustrative product launch, enter approved specifications, prices and prohibited claims in the project context. Generate a mail, social post and article outline, then check that quantities and eligibility agree across all three. A reusable template reduces rebriefing but also repeats stale information if the saved context is not updated.
sections.zh: 例如产品发布，把已批准规格、价格及禁用主张放入项目，生成邮件、社交及提纲，再核数量和资格一致。模板减少重复说明，但旧上下文未更新也会重复错误。

sections.title_en: Separate fair-use writing from enhanced and image capacity
sections.title_zh: 区分合理使用写作与增强/图片容量
sections.en: Annual totals are Starter $180 ($15/month), Pro $348 ($29) and Business $708 ($59). Starter lists one project/voice and twenty keyword searches/image credits per month; Pro three projects/five voices and one hundred each; Business ten projects/twenty voices, five hundred searches, nine hundred image credits and up to three invited members. Standard writing is unlimited under fair use; Enhanced has plan-based capacity, not a verified unlimited allowance.
sections.zh: 年总 Starter $180/折月 $15，Pro $348/$29，Business $708/$59。Starter 1 项目/声音、月搜索/图片各 20；Pro 3 项目/5 声音、各 100；Business 10/20、搜索 500/图片 900、最多邀请 3 人。Standard 按合理使用不限，Enhanced 有套餐容量，不能当无限。

sections.title_en: Keep WordPress output in a reviewed draft
sections.title_zh: 将 WordPress 输出留在审核草稿
sections.en: The site describes keyword research through brief, article, featured image and WordPress draft. Check the connected account’s permissions, links, formatting and image suitability before publication. The vendor explicitly does not guarantee SEO ranking. The trial lasts seven days, requires a card and must be cancelled before day seven to avoid charging; it is not a sustained free tier.
sections.zh: 网站介绍关键词到简报、文章、封面和 WordPress 草稿。发布前核连接账户权限、链接、格式及图片；厂商明确不保证 SEO 排名。七天试用需卡，须第七天前取消避扣，不是持续免费层。

sections.title_en: Validate V2 access and inherited-account terms
sections.title_zh: 确认 V2 访问及旧账户条款
sections.en: WordHero merits evaluation for repeat marketing campaigns needing shared context. Existing customers are told to use the same email and follow migration guidance; old lifetime or V1 rights are not assumed to map to V2. Test one brief, one revision and one export before migration. No Canvas, image, multilingual draft, WordPress action or billing was executed.
sections.zh: 重复营销活动需共享上下文时可评估 WordHero。旧客户被告知同邮箱按迁移指引操作，不能假定旧终身/V1 权利映射 V2。迁移前测试一个简报、一次修订和导出。本文未测 Canvas、图片、多语言、WordPress 或付款。

research_gaps: No Canvas, image, language, keyword result, WordPress or migration workflow tested.
Enhanced fair-use limits, old lifetime rights, data terms, license and self-hosting unknown.
Original WordHero product/pricing requests redirected to aivolut.com/wordhero; source URLs retain that actual final domain.
